description: Live status of AI models on Ezkielyna, one independent API gateway: success rate (24 h), uptime (7 d / 30 d), time to first token (p50/p90), output speed and request counts. Give "model" for one model, or leave it empty for the top N sorted by uptime, latency (fastest first token), speed (tokens/s) or requests (busiest). Free, no API key.

kind.description: Optional family filter as used by the status file: deepseek, gpt, claude, gemini, glm, qwen, kimi, minimax, image, video, audio, other.

min_requests_7d.description: For sort_by=uptime: ignore models with fewer answers in 7 days (a 100% uptime from 3 requests means little).

model.description: Model id, e.g. deepseek-v4.1-flash or claude-sonnet-5.5. Leave empty for a top-N list.

name: model_status
title: Model status (uptime, latency, speed)
